title: blipboard
description: Ambient split-flap display board agents push text to; humans watch it on any screen.
summary: Ambient split-flap display board agents push text to; humans watch it on any screen.
offersHint: Ambient split-flap display board agents push text to; humans watch it on any screen. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://blip-board.app/mcp

toolsPreview.name: create-board-tool
toolsPreview.description: Create a new Blipboard split-flap display board. Returns the display URL (open it on any screen — that IS the board, safe to share) and a secret pushToken used to push content later. No account needed.

toolsPreview.name: push-scenes-tool
toolsPreview.description: Push text scenes to a Blipboard board. Scenes replace your source's previous scenes by default and rotate as a playlist on the display. Requires the board's secret pushToken.

toolsPreview.name: read-board-tool
toolsPreview.description: Read what a Blipboard board is currently showing: its layout and the active scene playlist. No pushToken needed.

toolsPreview.name: update-board-tool
toolsPreview.description: Change a Blipboard board's look without recreating it: switch to a named style preset and/or set fine-grained style overrides (fonts, tile colors, flip speed, transitions). The open display picks the change up within ~10 seconds. Layout stays immutable. Requires the board's secret pushToken.

toolsPreview.name: delete-board-tool
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a Blipboard board and all its scenes. Requires the board's secret pushToken. This cannot be undone.
